pages.text: An orb of pure light, called up by a master so a pupil has something to swing at that will not swing back too hard. It hovers, weaves, and throws itself at whoever is holding the $(item)Keyblade$() — no malice in it, only the lesson.$(p)It carries its own glow, so a dark arena is no excuse for missing.$(p)$(lissa)$(l)$(o)[First Appearance: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep]$()
